dlf-phase-1.short_desc: Home tutors in DLF Phase 1, Gurugram: two or three matched tutors for your block and slot, each fee shown before a free demo class.
dlf-phase-1.about:
DLF Phase 1 is the oldest of the DLF phases, mostly independent houses and builder floors on residential lanes, with Arjun Marg, Qutab Plaza and the A to G blocks inside it and the Rapid Metro's Phase 1 station on its edge. This page covers the whole phase, including the roads and blocks that used to have pages of their own, such as Arjun Marg, Ashok Crescent Marg, Paschim Marg, Champa Marg, Kusum Marg, Sukhchain Marg, Silver Oaks Avenue, Deodar Marg, Amaltas Marg, the Sector 26A belt and the Golf Course Road side of E Block. If you searched for any of them, the tutors below are the right list.

In a floor there is usually no guard desk: the tutor simply rings the bell. The practical question is parking, because lanes are narrow and a tutor arriving by car can lose ten minutes finding a spot, so a tutor on a two-wheeler, or one dropped off, often arrives more reliably. Tell the tutor your block, house number and where they can park before the demo.

DLF Phase 1 sits in our Golf Course Road zone, next to the MG Road and Cyber City zone, and many tutors cover both. Office traffic on Golf Course Road and around the Rapid Metro builds from about six, so a class that starts before 5 pm, soon after the school bus drops your child home, or after about 7:30 pm is far easier to keep week after week. Because homes are close together, a tutor may teach two or three students in the phases on one evening, which makes an early-evening slot easier to fill.

Families in the DLF phases ask for CBSE and ICSE board-year help, most often maths and science in Classes 9 to 12, and for single IB or IGCSE components, such as IB Maths Analysis and Approaches at Higher Level or IGCSE Chemistry structured questions. Name the board, level and paper when you ask: see CBSE, ICSE and ISC, IB and IGCSE tutors in Gurgaon. Neighbouring DLF Phase 2 and Phase 3 share many of the same tutors.

We shortlist two or three matched tutors, and you see each fee before the free demo class. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Switching tutor later is free. Tutors who join go through an ID check. For the whole zone, read our guide to home tuition on Golf Course Road and in DLF, or browse all home tutors in Gurgaon.
faqs: Does this page cover Arjun Marg, Qutab Plaza and the DLF Phase 1 blocks?

Yes. The roads and blocks inside DLF Phase 1, such as Arjun Marg, Qutab Plaza, Ashok Crescent Marg, the A to G blocks and the Sector 26A belt, are all covered here. Tell us your block and house number and we shortlist tutors who can reach that exact lane at your slot.
Where should a home tutor park in DLF Phase 1?

Lanes in the phase are narrow, so agree a spot before the demo or suggest the tutor comes on a two-wheeler. There is usually no guard desk at a floor, so share the block, house number and a map pin, and the tutor can come straight to the door.
What time suits a class in DLF Phase 1?

A slot that starts before 5 pm, soon after the school bus, or after about 7:30 pm avoids the worst of the office traffic on Golf Course Road and around the Rapid Metro. A tutor already teaching nearby that evening is often the most punctual.
Can I find an IB or IGCSE tutor for one paper in DLF Phase 1?

Yes. Name the board, level and paper, for example IB Maths AA at Higher Level or IGCSE Chemistry. If nobody close by teaches it, we suggest an online specialist or a weekend home class with online sessions in between.
How are tutors checked before they teach in DLF Phase 1?

Tutors who join NXTutors confirm their phone or email with a one-time code and upload a government photo ID that our team reviews. It is not a police check, so meet the tutor at the free demo and keep an adult at home during classes.

dlf-phase-2.short_desc: Home tutors in DLF Phase 2, Gurugram, close to the office district: matched tutors, fees shown up front and a free demo class.
dlf-phase-2.about:
DLF Phase 2 is one of the older DLF phases, with independent floors on residential lanes and a few apartment clusters, and it lies close to the city's office district around Cyber City and MG Road. That location shapes home tuition here more than anything else: the roads nearby fill up twice a day as offices open and empty, in both directions, and many parents work in those same offices and get home late.

Two arrangements work well. The first is an early class, soon after the school bus drops your child home and before the evening office rush. The second, for families where both parents work late, is online classes on weekdays with the same tutor and a longer home session at the weekend when a parent is in. Whichever you choose, keep the weekday slot fixed: rescheduling at short notice is hard when every road is busy at the same hour. Ask the tutor whether they will come from home or from another class nearby, because a tutor already teaching in the phases that evening is usually more punctual.

DLF Phase 2 belongs to our Golf Course Road zone, and it borders the MG Road and Cyber City zone, so tutors listed on either zone page may suit you. In a floor, the tutor walks straight to the door, so share the house number, a map pin and where to park; narrow lanes make a two-wheeler easier than a car.

Requests from the phases are specific: CBSE and ICSE families most often ask for maths and physics or chemistry help in Classes 9 to 12, and international-school families for one IB or IGCSE component; see IB tutors and IGCSE tutors in Gurgaon. Neighbouring DLF Phase 1 and Phase 3 have their own pages.

You get two or three matched tutors with each fee shown before the free demo class, and switching tutor later is free. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Tutors who join go through an ID check. Read our Golf Course Road and DLF tuition guide or browse all home tutors in Gurgaon.
faqs: Do home tutors come to DLF Phase 2 on weekday evenings?

Yes, but the tutor's starting point matters. Office traffic around Cyber City and MG Road peaks in the evening, so a tutor from the DLF phases or a nearby sector, or one with a class close by just before yours, is usually the most reliable. An early slot after school also helps.
Both of us work late. How can tuition fit in DLF Phase 2?

A common pattern is online classes on weekday evenings with the same tutor, plus a longer home session at the weekend when a parent is at home. Keep at least one home class where the tutor sees written work, and set up a camera over the notebook for online ones.
Which zone page should I check for DLF Phase 2?

DLF Phase 2 is in our Golf Course Road zone, and it sits beside the MG Road and Cyber City zone. Many tutors cover both, so it is worth looking at the tutors listed on both zone pages if your preferred slot is hard to fill.
What does the first class cost in DLF Phase 2?

Nothing: the first class is a free demo on your child's current topic, at home or online. You see each shortlisted tutor's fee before it, because tutors set their own fees, and if the tutor stops suiting your child later, switching is free.
Are tutors in DLF Phase 2 checked?

Tutors who join NXTutors go through an ID check: a one-time code on their phone or email and a government photo ID reviewed by our team. It is not a police check, so meet the tutor at the demo and keep lessons in a shared room.

dlf-phase-3.short_desc: Home tutors in DLF Phase 3, Gurugram, on the Cyber City side: two or three matched tutors, fees shown, and a free demo class.
dlf-phase-3.about:
DLF Phase 3 lies on the Cyber City side of the DLF phases, next to Nathupur and within reach of NH-48, so for a home tutor it behaves partly like the DLF phases and partly like the office district. Most homes are independent floors and apartments on residential lanes, where the tutor comes straight to the door, but the roads around the phase carry office traffic in the morning and again as offices empty.

That makes the tutor's starting point the first thing to check. Tutors who live in the DLF phases, Nathupur, Sikanderpur or Sectors 24 to 29 handle the office rush most easily, and one who has a class nearby just before yours is often more punctual than one leaving home. The Rapid Metro serves Cyber City, which helps a tutor who travels by train. If weekday evenings are impossible, weekend home classes plus online sessions during the week work well here.

DLF Phase 3 is part of our Golf Course Road zone, and the neighbouring MG Road and Cyber City zone lists more tutors who reach this side of the city. In a floor, agree where the tutor can park; in an apartment block, give the guard the tutor's name before the demo.

For Classes 9 and 10, families here most often ask for CBSE or ICSE maths and science; for Classes 11 and 12, a separate specialist per subject, which our Class 11 and Class 12 home tutors in Gurgaon pages explain. International-school students can start with IB or IGCSE tutors. See also DLF Phase 2 and DLF Phase 4.

We send two or three matched tutors, each with the fee shown before the free demo class, and switching tutor later is free. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Tutors who join go through an ID check. Read the Golf Course Road and DLF tuition guide or browse all home tutors in Gurgaon.
faqs: Which tutors reach DLF Phase 3 most easily?

Tutors from the DLF phases, Nathupur, Sikanderpur or Sectors 24 to 29, and anyone already teaching nearby that evening. They avoid the long crawl through office traffic around Cyber City, which matters more for a weekday evening class than the distance on the map.
Can a tutor come to DLF Phase 3 by metro?

Often, yes. The Rapid Metro serves Cyber City, so a tutor who travels by train can finish the trip with a short ride or walk. Ask each shortlisted tutor how they will travel on your class days and at what time.
What if weekday evenings do not work for us in DLF Phase 3?

Use weekend home classes, when roads are quieter and a parent is usually in, with online sessions with the same tutor on weekdays. For a board-year student, keep the weekday online slot fixed so the routine holds.
Should a Class 11 student in DLF Phase 3 have one tutor or several?

Usually several. Physics, Chemistry and Maths deepen sharply in Class 11, and a separate specialist for each often serves a student better than one tutor for everything. Tell us which subject is weakest and we start there.
What does home tuition cost in DLF Phase 3?

Tutors set their own fees, shown before the free demo. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.

dlf-phase-4.short_desc: Home tutors in DLF Phase 4, Gurugram: matched maths, science, CBSE, ICSE, IB and IGCSE tutors, fees shown, free demo class.
dlf-phase-4.about:
DLF Phase 4 is one of the DLF phases at the heart of our Golf Course Road zone, mostly independent houses and builder floors on residential lanes, with Sushant Lok 1 close by and DLF Phase 5 next door. Because homes in the phases are close together, many tutors teach two or three students here on one evening, and a tutor already in Phase 4 at 5 pm can reach Phase 5 far more easily than one driving in from another zone. That makes an early-evening slot in Phase 4 easier to fill than in most of the city.

What families in Phase 4 ask for is usually specific. CBSE and ICSE students in Classes 9 to 12 most often need maths home tutors, science, physics or chemistry, and international-school students often want help with one paper, such as IB Maths at Higher Level or IGCSE Maths Extended. Name the board, level and paper when you ask, and share a recent marked test so the demo is on real work.

A few practical points for a home class here. In a floor there is usually no guard desk, so the tutor rings the bell; tell them where to park, because lanes are narrow and a two-wheeler often arrives faster than a car. Office traffic on Golf Course Road and around the Rapid Metro builds from about six, so a class that starts before 5 pm or after 7:30 pm is easier to keep. Tutors from Central Gurugram and the South City side usually reach the phase without trouble in the afternoon.

faqs: Is it easy to find a maths home tutor in DLF Phase 4?

Usually, yes. Many tutors already teach in the DLF phases, often two or three students on one evening, so an early-evening slot is easier to fill here than in newer parts of the city. Tell us the board, class and the chapter causing trouble, and we shortlist two or three maths tutors.
Can one tutor teach my child at home in DLF Phase 4 and online on other days?
Yes, and in this zone it often makes sense. A home class early in the week for new topics, plus a short online session on a busy evening, avoids the worst office traffic while keeping the same tutor.
Do tutors from DLF Phase 5 or Sushant Lok also teach in Phase 4?

Often. The phases sit close together and Sushant Lok 1 is next door, so tutors move between them easily. Ask each shortlisted tutor where they will be travelling from on your class days, as that matters more than their home address.
What time works well for a class in DLF Phase 4?
Before 5 pm, soon after the school bus drops your child home, or after about 7:30 pm. Those slots avoid the office traffic that builds on Golf Course Road and around the Rapid Metro from about six.
What does the free demo class in DLF Phase 4 involve?

It is an ordinary lesson on your child's current topic, at home or online, so you see how the tutor actually teaches. You already know the tutor's fee by then. If the demo does not convince you, we arrange one with the next tutor on your shortlist.

dlf-phase-5.short_desc: Home tutors in DLF Phase 5, Gurugram, off Golf Course Road: IB, IGCSE, CBSE and ICSE tutors, fees shown, free demo class.
dlf-phase-5.about:
DLF Phase 5 lies along Golf Course Road, where the DLF phases meet the gated towers of Sectors 53 and 54, so it has both kinds of home our Golf Course Road zone is known for: independent floors on residential lanes, where the tutor rings the bell and the only question is parking, and gated high-rise estates, where parking is easy once inside but the tutor must be approved at the gate first. For a tower, register the tutor on your society's visitor app or with the gate once, ideally as a regular visitor, so the first class does not start late.

Requests from Phase 5 are among the most specific in the city. A parent is as likely to ask for IB Maths Analysis and Approaches at Higher Level, an IB Physics internal assessment plan or IGCSE Chemistry structured questions as for general Class 8 maths, and CBSE and ICSE families add board-year maths and science. For IB or IGCSE, ask the tutor which papers and command terms they have taught recently, not just the subject; start with IB tutors, IB Maths tutors, IGCSE tutors or maths home tutors in Gurgaon. If nobody close by teaches the exact paper, an online specialist or a weekend home class with online sessions in between fills the gap.

Timing matters on Golf Course Road. Office traffic along the road and around the Rapid Metro builds from about six, so a class soon after the school bus drops your child home, or one that starts after about 7:30 pm, is much easier to keep. Tutors who live in the DLF phases or Sushant Lok 1 reach you in a short drive, and a tutor already teaching in DLF Phase 4 that evening can reach Phase 5 easily. Tutors from Golf Course Extension Road can reach this southern end of the road reasonably well; see Golf Course Extn.

DLF Phase 5 is in our Golf Course Road zone; the zone page lists every area and the tutors who cover them, and our Golf Course Road and DLF tuition guide goes further. Tutors who join go through an ID check. Browse all home tutors in Gurgaon.
faqs: Can I find a tutor for one IB or IGCSE paper in DLF Phase 5?

Yes. Families here often want help with a single component, such as IB Maths AA at Higher Level or an IB Physics internal assessment. Name the board, level and paper when you ask; if nobody close by teaches it, we suggest an online specialist or a hybrid plan with a weekend home class.
Is a DLF floor or a Golf Course Road tower easier for a home tutor?

Each has one hurdle. In a floor the tutor walks straight to your door but may struggle to park, so a two-wheeler often suits. In a tower, parking is simple once inside, but the tutor must be approved at the gate first, ideally as a regular visitor.
Which slot works best for home tuition in DLF Phase 5?

A class that starts before 5 pm, soon after the school bus, or after about 7:30 pm avoids the office traffic that builds on Golf Course Road from about six. Weekend mornings are also easier to fill with specialist tutors.
Do tutors from Golf Course Extension Road come to DLF Phase 5?

Many do, especially in the afternoon, because Phase 5 is at the southern end of Golf Course Road. Ask each shortlisted tutor where they will set out from on your class days, as that matters more than where they live.
How much does an IB or IGCSE tutor cost in DLF Phase 5?

Tutors set their own fees, shown before the free demo. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.

-golf-course-extn.short_desc: Home tutors on Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram (Sectors 55 to 66): matched tutors, fees shown up front and a free demo class.
-golf-course-extn.about:
Golf Course Extension Road runs through Sectors 55 to 66, from Sectors 55, 56 and 57 at the northern end, past Sectors 58 to 62, on to Sectors 63, 65 and 66, with a band of HUDA plots in between. Most families live in large gated societies, many built in recent years, where visitor apps, guard calls and a long walk from the gate to the tower are part of every tutor's arrival. NXTutors' own office is in Sector 66, on this road, so it is the part of Gurugram we know most closely.

Three things decide whether a home class here runs on time. First, some societies stop visitor entry after a set evening hour, which quietly decides the latest home slot you can book, so check the cut-off with your management office before choosing a time and move any later doubt session online. Second, a large society can take ten minutes from the gate to the tower, so approve the tutor on the society app the day before the demo, tell them the nearest gate and where visitors park, and ask for them to be noted as a frequent visitor afterwards. Third, children here often travel some way to school, so give them a break after the bus before the tutor arrives.

Families on the Extension Road ask for CBSE, IB and IGCSE across all classes. Tutors living on this road or in the Sohna Road sectors reach most societies comfortably, and weekend mornings tend to have more free tutors than weekday evenings. For specialist subjects such as IB Maths at Higher Level or IGCSE Additional Maths, it can be worth taking a tutor from further away for weekend home sessions with online classes in between; see IB tutors, IGCSE tutors, CBSE home tutors and maths home tutors in Gurgaon.

faqs: Which sectors are on Golf Course Extension Road?

Sectors 55 to 66, including Sectors 55, 56, 57, 58, 60, 61, 62, 63, 65 and 66, and the HUDA plots between the societies. North of Sector 55 is the Golf Course Road zone, and the Southern Peripheral Road sectors, 73 to 80, have their own zone page.
Our society closes visitor entry early. Can we still have home tuition?

Yes, as long as the home class ends before the cut-off. Ask your management office for the exact time before choosing a slot, and book the tutor comfortably ahead of it. Anything later, such as a doubt session before a test, can move online with the same tutor.
Why does the first class in a large society often start late?

The guard call, the ID check at the gate and the walk to the right tower all take time on a first visit. Approve the tutor on the society app the day before, tell them the nearest gate and where visitors park, and ask the management to note them as a frequent visitor.
Is NXTutors only for families near its Sector 66 office?

No. The office is on Golf Course Extension Road, but we arrange home tutoring across Gurugram and online tutoring across India. Wherever you live, you get two or three matched tutors, see each fee before a free demo class, and can switch tutor later at no cost.
How are tutors checked before visiting our society?

Tutors who join NXTutors confirm their phone or email with a one-time code and upload a government photo ID that our team reviews. It is not a police check, so meet the tutor at the demo and register them on your visitor app.
